title: Claude Code expands video editing with ChatKart’s AI-powered #ClaudeCode #AIediting #videotech
description: Claude Code integrated with ChatKart's new plugin to offer a full AI-powered video editor within the same timeline. Users can streamline editing by removing dead air, cutting repeats, adding captions, B-roll, motion graphics, music, and voiceovers directly alongside AI-assisted planning and execution. This innovation replaces fragmented workflows and limited template tools with a flexible, editable system that understands complex requests and adapts to user preferences. Clip management is enhanced through access to footage stored in Google Drive, enabling efficient creation of multiple video versions with varied hooks. The ability to save and reuse editing workflows across projects offers scalability and productivity gains for content creators and video professionals, marking a significant advance in AI-driven video production. #ClaudeCode #ChatKart #AIVideoEditing #VideoEditor #ContentCreation #VideoProduction #AIWorkflow #GoogleDriveIntegration #MotionGraphics #VoiceoverAI #ShortVideoCreation #VideoAutomation #ContentMarketing #AIVideoTools #CreativeTech
